blocks.intro: McHenry's emergencies follow the water and the weather.

items.h3: High Water and Failed Sump Pumps
items.body: When the Fox River and the lakes rise, sump pumps run nonstop. In July 2017, after heavy rain and river flooding, the state declared McHenry County a disaster area. See [sump pumps](/mchenry/sump-pumps).

items.h3: Water Heaters Worn Down by Hard Water
items.body: Hard groundwater shortens water heater life. When a tank fails, it can flood the basement fast. See [water heater repair](/mchenry/water-heater-repair).
McHenry County winters bring long stretches below freezing. Pipes in exterior walls, crawl spaces and garages freeze first. See [burst pipe repair](/mchenry/burst-pipe-repair).
Lake homes that sit empty in winter can freeze if the heat fails. A leak can run for days before anyone notices.

blocks.h2: Emergency Plumbing Questions From McHenry Homeowners

items.q: How quickly can you get to my home in McHenry?
items.preview: Call any time. We'll give you a realistic window.
items.answer: Call us any time. Our West Elm Street office keeps us close to McHenry and the lake communities. Arrival times depend on the day and call volume, but we'll give you a realistic window and get a plumber to you as soon as we can.

items.q: My lake house has no water and it's below zero. What now?
items.preview: Turn off the main and the well pump, then call.
items.answer: Close the main valve and, if you're on a well, turn off the pump at the breaker. Open a faucet and don't use heat guns or torches on frozen pipes. Call us and we'll thaw and check the lines.

items.q: The river is up and my sump pump just quit. What do I do?
items.preview: Check the breaker, start the backup and move valuables.
items.answer: Check the breaker and the plug, make sure the backup is running and move anything valuable off the floor. Then call us.

items.q: Do you serve Johnsburg, Wonder Lake and Fox Lake?
items.answer: Yes. Our McHenry office serves the lake communities around the Chain O'Lakes.

items.q: What does an emergency plumber cost in McHenry?
items.preview: It depends on the problem. The price comes first.
items.answer: Every emergency is priced on what's wrong and what it takes to fix. You'll have a flat-rate number before we start.
